mechanics.claim: The bomb explodes upon arrival, dealing full damage to enemies at the epicenter and reduced damage (65%) to those outside it.
mechanics.quote: The bomb explodes upon arrival to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 65% against those outside of the epicenter.

mechanics.claim: Mega Inferno Bomb can be blocked by a spell shield.
The bomb has variable travel time depending on cast distance, fixed within a threshold and scaling with distance beyond it.
mechanics.quote: ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' takes {{fd|2.64}} seconds from the start of the cast time to land when cast at maximum range (reduced to {{fd|1.617}} seconds from the start of the cast time when casting within {{tt|2700|Estimated}} units).
